answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks with Proof of Space-Time over stacked depth-robust graphs. Each agent blends its key like a pigment into sequential hash layers to seal a sector, then answers beacon-seeded Merkle read proofs. Graph dependencies form a compute ridge against fast regeneration, forcing dedicated disk per identity instead of virtual keys on a chip smaller than a walnut at low cost. However, adversaries with bulk storage or ASIC sealers can still host clusters.
